description: Unmodified Kurucz K13 observed-level Fe II rows absent from the bundled Stout transitions.

si_ii_1190_region.criterion: Missing E1 transitions with both energy and statistical weight matching existing Stout Fe II levels within 0.1 cm^-1 and equal weight; positive Kurucz level-energy signs.

fe_ii_1357_1361_region.criterion: Missing transitions at the observed 1357.8 feature and the 1361.37 blend; positive Kurucz level-energy signs.

unchanged: All pre-existing Stout levels, transitions, oscillator strengths and damping data; all other ions.

references.supports: Fe II 1361.37 lower excitation 1.671 eV identifies the missing 1361.374 component.
Lists both Fe II 1361.363 and 1361.374 in the COS line inventory.
Identifies Fe II 1190.883 and 1193.575 in the observed B-star UV atlas.
Identifies Fe II 1191.356 and 1195.055 with compatible energy/gf data.

cautions: Positive Kurucz energy signs indicate observed rather than predicted levels; the oscillator strengths are Kurucz calculations, not laboratory measurements.
The 1357.796 upper level is absent from the bundled Stout/NIST laboratory-confirmed level set; its Kurucz observed energy is retained with this explicit provenance.
Existing Fe II 1360.858 uses the NIST-evaluated Raassen/Uylings (1998) f; it is not replaced by the larger Kurucz value.
No abundance, profile scale or transition-strength adjustment is fitted to the white dwarfs.
